panels.description: Known instrumentation limitation.

options.content:
### Cleaner heartbeat limitation

The expired-message cleaner has no dedicated heartbeat metric. Use **Worker availability** for process reachability and **cleaner passes** in the adjacent panel as the current activity signal. A zero message-expiry rate is normal when no messages expire.

panels.title: Cleaner health interpretation
